observations.summary: MOVSXD R15,R8D takes signed low32 of inherited R8; TEST R8D followed by JLE leaves this window at 993643 when signed value <=0. This does not authenticate a count.

Each visited loop iteration rereads QWORD[current R13+70] then QWORD[base+RSI*8] into RDI. Unfollowed d959b0 receives RCX=R12,RDX=&F68,R8=that value; subsequent EBX is fresh DWORD[F68]. This fragment does not initialize F68 or prove callee writes it.

Constructs local12B DWORD at F20 and QWORD at F24. If fresh QWORD[P+8] != fresh QWORD[P+10], writes DWORD[cursor] and QWORD[cursor+4], then ADD64[P+8],12. Only equality is checked; no pointer/bounds/capacity validation or C++ record meaning is established.

Equal branch calls 996e30 with RCX=current P,RDX=the compared cursor,R8=&F20; local intervening instructions do not change RDX. R9/XMM and callee effects unknown; no local header increment on this branch before the join.

The join performs ADD32[current R14],EBX. It is a 32-bit read-modify-write modulo2^32, not a 64-bit amount, not proof of units or final D; previous calls/alias writes may have changed the current destination.

INC64 RSI then signed CMP/JL loops; positive-path epilogue MOV RAX,R14 precedes saved-register POPs. RAX is current R14 bits at that point, not the DWORD value. One RET is owned; external lowcount target and R69 null target remain unread.
